chunks: And it has been narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: I took some dust from the dust of the Maqām, and soil from the soil of the House, and seven pebbles.
So he said: “What you have done is bad. As for the soil and the pebbles, then return them.”

key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: the Maqām, referring to the sacred standing place associated with Ibrāhīm عليه السلام
key_terms.سُكًّا: dust or fine earth taken from a place

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to take soil or pebbles from the Kaʿbah or Maqām during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that taking soil and pebbles from the sacred precincts was disapproved by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام. It indicates a ruling of respect for the sanctity of the Kaʿbah and its associated sacred places during hajj.
